text: Television reporter Ángela Vidal and her cameraman Pablo follow Barcelona firefighters on a night call to an apartment building, where an elderly resident [bites a police officer|rules|it passes to others]. Authorities [seal the building under quarantine|images|the house and its rooms], trapping residents and rescuers inside as more of them turn violent. Climbing toward the penthouse with the infected behind them, Ángela and Pablo find religious material and a tape about a sick girl whose [illness was thought to be possession|threat|being taken over], while the camera keeps rolling.
